name: RemoveDuplicateItemsFromList
label: Remove Duplicate Items From List
description: Removes duplicate items from a list using case-sensitive or case-insensitive comparison.

fields.name: ListToDeduplicate
fields.label: List to Deduplicate
fields.description: The list variable to remove duplicate values from.

fields.name: IgnoreCase
fields.label: Ignore Case
fields.description: If true, performs case-insensitive comparison when checking for duplicates.

fields.name: DeduplicatedList
fields.label: Deduplicated List
fields.description: Returns the list after removing duplicate items.
